observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Stage of a public performance hall, with a banner in the background.
observation.dancers: Group of 12 dancers, mixed men and women, in couples.
observation.formation_and_space: Circle formation, moving clockwise and counter-clockwise.
observation.posture: Upright torso, knees slightly bent, weight shifts between feet.
observation.footwork: Rhythmic stepping, including side-to-side steps, small hops, and stamps on the beat.
observation.arms_and_hands: Dancers hold hands in a circle, sometimes raising them, sometimes lowering them.
observation.hips_and_torso: Minimal torso movement, focus on leg and foot coordination.
observation.partnering: Couples hold hands, sometimes changing partners as they move around the circle.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Small hops and rhythmic stamps, no complex floor work or high jumps.
observation.costume_and_props: Traditional Romanian folk costumes: women in white blouses, embroidered vests, and skirts; men in white shirts, vests, and trousers.
observation.cannot_infer: The low resolution makes it difficult to see the exact weight transfer or the finer details of the footwork.

signature_moments.what: The group moves in a circle, holding hands, with rhythmic side-stepping.
Couples perform a small, rhythmic hop while holding hands.
